rule: One work, one source; prior pilot registration is not new evidence.
Already governed pilot sources are carried by reference, not re-registered.
Different populations and protocols; directness to the exact endpoint differs, so do not pool as identical replication.
Correction review and included/related primary work cannot be counted as independent replication of an exact new claim.
INF-F07 does not mint a second additive repetition-to-belief contribution.
